about_the_game:
Near Future...

Global Warming turned into a catastrophic event. The Earth is now dominated by open seas, storms, and modern-day pirates. Different ambitious factions are trying to control the sea routes, trade, and wealth...As a member of the BOFTC, you will raid the huge cruise ships, container ships, and tankers. Get rich or die trying!

Action-Packed TPS Experience: Gather your squad, pick your mission, design your strategy, and go for glory! You will board a huge ship, fight your way in against different types of enemies, complete the main mission, loot the ship for valuable artifacts, and extract!



Dynamic Missions: Huge variation of different ship types, ship states, and endless combinations of missions. Every session, every mission,

A brand new experience. 

Different Classes, Different Toys: Each class has its strengths. You can choose to be a combat intelligence, use your drone to spot enemies, hack the terminals, and stay in control. Or... Pick the Brute, destroy everything on your way out!



Home Sweet Home: Find valuable items, become rich, and build your dream home. Items you find on the ships will grow your net worth, unlock bigger houses, and more items to decorate your home.



Faction Dominance: Each faction in the open seas will offer you different types of unique abilities and weapons. Every mission you complete for a faction will help their cause: dominate the seas, technology, and wealth.



Explore: As you get more experience, you will be able to reach more and more areas on the open seas. But be cautious, open seas are unknown, dark, and dangerous!

content_descriptors.notes: Calypso is a heist game where you board special ships and eliminate the enemy soldiers. Contains gun violence and shooting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64 Bit Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Calypso: Brethren Of The Coast is a co-op TPS heist game that takes place in a post-apocalyptic near future dominated by seas. Raid different ships, complete missions, loot for valuable items, and become rich!
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
